split_rule: Shift the CD02 anchor-based split boundaries 30 days earlier with the prediction anchor. Keep the dataset observation cutoff unchanged. Require every CVE's role to equal its saved CD02 role. This is a publication-cohort-aligned two-endpoint design, not identical calendar forecast cutoffs.
source_rule: Reapply the frozen source adapter at Day 30. SMP dates must be strictly before the anchor, present, parseable and nonconflicting. Descriptions and summaries remain retrospective. Build a new full eligible-training text registry; mask only optional matching validation documents. Never reuse Day-60 source masks.
eligibility_rule: At least one observed input EPSS on Days 0-30 and an observed Day-60 target. Keep partial histories and missing text sources. Do not require a Day-90 score or select by score magnitude.

planned_matched_training.settings_rule: Reuse the fixed MS03 model family and optimizer settings in a separately versioned Day-60 runner after this export and its graph cache are verified. All three variants must use identical Day-60 CVEs. No optimizer tuning is performed by this preparation.

limitations: CVE identities are distinct, not proven unrelated vulnerability families. Shared descriptions are retained.
Current descriptions and summaries are not verified Day-30 snapshots. Text may describe later events.
Stored SMP date screening is not proof of historical publication or content availability.
EPSS dates do not prove the exact daily score release time.
Boundary dates differ between horizons to preserve publication cohorts; horizon-specific eligibility can still differ.
The existing 651 reserved CVE roles are preserved, but their Day-60 target eligibility is not inspected in this stage.
Earlier validation has informed development. These are development exports, not final independent evaluation.
The MS03 learned branches collapsed. Completing this endpoint does not promise an improvement or change its frozen results.
